control_flow: Forever: followInTheDark: if the right light is below 60 % go deeper, else avoidWalls.
followInTheDark (dim): if the left light is below 45 % curve left, else if the line tracker reads over 95 % curve right, else avoidWalls.
avoidWalls: if the left light is below 70 % and an obstacle is on the left turn right, else if on the right turn left, else driveInTheDark; if bright, driveInTheDark.
driveInTheDark: if the left light is below 70 % drive forward, else stopAtWall.
stopAtWall: if an obstacle is ahead stop, else followLine.
followLine: if the line tracker sees black curve left, else curve right.

likely_intent.description: Follow the black line, and keep following it in the dark (inside a tunnel) too.

decision_points.condition: the right light sensor RLIGHT reads below 60 %

branches.outcome: dim on the right: it looks deeper into the dark logic
bright on the right (60 % or more): it goes on to avoidWalls

decision_points.condition: in dim light: first the left light LLIGHT below 45 %, second the line tracker above 95 %

branches.outcome: very dark on the left: it curves left (15/35)

branches.reason: Only reachable in the narrow band of light just inside a tunnel where the right light is below 60 % but the left light is above 45 %, and the line tracker happens to sit on the white band.
branches.outcome: not very dark but the line tracker reads over 95 % (white band): it curves right (35/15)
neither: it goes on to avoidWalls

decision_points.condition: the left light sensor LLIGHT reads below 70 %

branches.outcome: dim: it checks the side obstacle sensors
bright: it goes on to driveInTheDark

decision_points.condition: in dim light: first an obstacle on the LEFT, second an obstacle on the RIGHT

branches.outcome: an obstacle on the left: it turns right 20°
an obstacle on the right: it turns left 20°
no side obstacle: it goes on to driveInTheDark

decision_points.condition: the left light sensor LLIGHT reads below 70 %

branches.outcome: dim: it drives straight forward at 30 %
bright: it goes on to stopAtWall
an obstacle is ahead: it stops
no obstacle ahead: it goes on to followLine

uncertainties: You said the robot should follow the line in the dark, but in the dark your program never reads the line tracker's black: it drives straight or curves left by the light level and may bump into the tunnel wall.
In dim light but not yet very dark, the robot curves right only if the line tracker reads over 95 % (the white band); that window is narrow and hard to hit, so that branch is uncertain.
You didn't say what the robot should do at a wall in the light or when it meets the tunnel's wall in a bend: those situations have no expected behaviour from your sentence.
The simulator counts one clap several times in a fast loop, but this program has no clap logic.
